In its main business, the steel structure manufacturing business, it sets out an order strategy focused on the Chubu region and development of sales activities in other regions, in bridge preservation a focus on large-scale renewal of expressways and floor slab replacement work, and in steel frames and steel structures initiatives for ultra-high-rise projects in the Tokyo metropolitan area, and states that the real estate leasing business will secure a certain scale as a stable source of income and the materials sales business will advance development of new customers and increased sales to existing customers. It also indicates that, as the final year approaches, it revised the plan's numerical targets in light of the business environment.
